corrections.replace: - derive/([wfghkz])ei$/$1ie/  # ReRime: tei (忒) is a real syllable; typed tie must not also read tei
corrections.reason: The typo derivation turns tei into tie, so a correct tie (铁, 贴) silently also offers 忒 with no correction mark. It is the only one of the 38 typo derivations that collides with a real syllable.
